revision_policy: Includes two rounds of post-production edits on the rough cuts.

milestones.condition: Due upon delivery of first rough cut review
Due prior to delivery of master raw files

risk_rules.recommended_fix: Incorporate a weather contingency backup shoot date in the schedule assumptions.
Add standard licensing clause stating client covers all royalty fees.
Assign license costs, permissions, talent releases, and location permits.
List each export format, duration, and aspect ratio as a deliverable.

client_responsibilities: Provide product details and brand guidelines
Approve storyboards and script files before shooting
Secure permission rights for shooting locations
timeline_assumptions: Shooting dates are finalized at least 14 days in advance.
Review comments on rough cuts are submitted within 5 business days.
acceptance_criteria: Storyboards are finalized and signed off.
Master video matches approved script directions.
Final video files meet exporting specs.

revision: Re-shoots after storyboard sign-off are billed as separate creative changes, not revision rounds.
payment: Invoices for shooting milestones must be cleared before camera crews go active on location.
out_of_scope: Any extra voiceover edits or foreign translation work is scoped separately.
client_responsibilities: Client is responsible for getting clearance waivers for all employee faces appearing in the video.
ip_ownership: Full usage rights transfer to client, while raw camera assets remain property of the studio.
change_request: Changes to shooting dates within 7 days of production trigger a rescheduling fee of 15%.
Any request that changes approved deliverables, timing, assumptions, or acceptance criteria requires written approval before work begins.
timeline: Timeline estimates assume standard weather patterns, and shifts may occur for natural safety factors.
Milestones depend on timely client feedback, access, content, approvals, and third-party provider availability.

hidden_scope_traps: Additional shoot days requested after pre-production approval
Talent, location, music, and licensing responsibilities undefined
Revision rounds expanding due to late stakeholder feedback
Alternate aspect ratios, cutdowns, or subtitles expected without scoping
